name: Nocturnal-Cirque
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
